messages:
matt: Heads up — release window in 50m for v2.8.1. I tried to kick the deploy but got `permission_denied` from deploy-bot. Anyone else seeing MFA issues?
priya: I hit the same, deploy-bot says my deployer role token expired. MFA prompt didn't surface on my phone. :confused: 
deploy-bot: Deploy request rejected for @priya. Reason: `deployer_role_mfa:expired`. AuditID: ab12-3cd4. See /deploy logs.
evan: I'm oncall but OOO remote, can take it if we need to press. How long is the window?
matt: Window is 18:00-19:00 PT, it's 17:08 atm. We shouldn't go past the window without PM signoff.
tessa: Do we have a short rollback/patch plan if we postpone? We could pin traffic to v2.8.0 and ship a fast patch tomorrow if needed.
priya: If we wait for MFA re-enroll that'll take ~15m for me. Is there a delegated account we can use?
evan: We have a temporary cross-team JIT procedure but it requires two approvals. @matt can you +1?
matt: I can approve. @tessa please confirm SRE +1.
tessa: SRE +1 for temporary JIT, but only for the canary subset. No full prod until post-canary checks pass. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: JIT access granted to @evan for `deployer` role. Expires in 30m. TokenID: tk-9f8e. Actions logged.
evan: Applying canary deploy now: `./deploy --model service-api --version v2.8.1 --canary 5%`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started. Instance group: api-prod-a. Progress: 0/20 -> 2/20. Logs: https://deploy.logs/release/ab12-3cd4
priya: FYI release notes PR needs a small doc update (config flag change). I'll push that now.
matt: Thanks. If canary looks OK at +5m we do full rollout. If errors spike, we abort and pin back to v2.8.0.
evan: Canary metrics look clean at +7m. No 5xx, latency steady.
tessa: Observability: added a threshold alert at 1.5x baseline for 95th p95.
matt: Going to proceed with gradual rollout. Keep monitoring. Also note: postmortem checklist — record MFA failure and JIT steps so we tighten the onboarding flow.
priya: Created a follow-up ticket: onboarding/MFA-improve (link: https://rwd/issue/1234).
evan: Full rollout complete. deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 17:32 PT. Release tag: v2.8.1.
tessa: Updating release notes now and tagging PM. Good job team. :tada:
matt: Action items: 1) document MFA hiccup in runbook, 2) add heartbeat to deploy-bot to surface MFA prompt earlier, 3) verify JIT approvals audit. I'll follow up in the release thread.
